entries.guarantee: A run driven by a durable engine progresses through its generate/tool steps and reaches a terminal completed state — with the completion event firing and the owning session persisted as completed — exactly as an in-memory run does.
entries.blackBoxTest: packages/bureau/src/create-bureau.test.ts > createBureau > routes runs through the durable engine end-to-end when durableExecution is on

notRuled.reason: AB-92's Decision (2026-09-01), "Test-helper parity (AC6)", rules armorer's ExecutionLifecycle.inspect/abort as production public surface, not adapter tools reaching internals on behalf of a missing public guarantee. This file's imports of execution-lifecycle.ts internals are same-package (armorer testing its own module under test) and would never be reported by this gate regardless of this ruling; the entry exists so a later reader does not add a manifest pairing here that AB-92 already forecloses.
